construct: ALPK3 is an atypical cardiac pseudokinase that functions as a scaffold at the sarcomeric M-band and nuclear envelope. Loss disrupts localization of myomesins and other M-band proteins and impairs sarcomeric proteostasis, producing hypertrophic or dilated cardiomyopathy.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A pathogenic ALPK3 truncating variant with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy/fibrosis identifies ALPK3 cardiomyopathy. Current mechanistic studies characterize ALPK3 as an atypical pseudokinase/scaffold at the M-band and nuclear envelope that supports myomesin localization and sarcomeric proteostasis.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Troponin phosphorylation would require catalytic kinase activity, whereas ALPK3 is characterized as a pseudokinase; RyR channels, desmoplakin, and myosin ATPase belong to calcium release, desmosomes, and force generation respectively.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The item tests the best-supported normal ALPK3 role at the same molecular granularity across options; no alternative matches the current ALPK3 mechanistic literature.
